messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: p99 latency breach detected for continuous-batching hotpath (us-west-2). Affected route: /v1/generate (streaming enabled). Current p99 = 3.1s (SLO 0.9s). Trigger: tail latency spike starting ~10m ago. Please ack and triage.

Aisha (eng-oncall): Acked. I'm looking at the dashboard now. p95 ~ 650ms, p99 jumped to 3s+, streaming stall rate up x5.

Aisha (eng-oncall): Quick checks: GPU utilization on batchers in us-west-2 is normal (70-85%), but paging iowait on the KV-cache hosts is high. Also seeing lots of mixed seq_len batches (avg seq_len variance high).

Ben (eng-runtime): Noted. Mixed sequence lengths + large batches historically amplify tail. Any recent rollout to scheduler or kernel changes?

Carlos (eng-sre): No infra rollouts in the last 2 hours. Cloud-side EBS alerts: increased latency on a subset of cache-backed instances in us-west-2a. Could be causing streaming stalls when KV lookups page.

Aisha (eng-oncall): Repro commands from my shell:
```bash
# quick fetch of recent failed streaming traces
jq -r '.traces[] | select(.route=="/v1/generate")' /var/log/trace-collector/usw2.json | head -n 50
```
Outputs show many traces stuck waiting on `kv_get` for 40-90ms before kernel resumes.

Ben (eng-runtime): Mitigation plan proposal (quick):
1) Reduce continuous-batch max_batch_size from 16 -> 8 for us-west-2 to reduce head-of-line amplification. (config flag: `CONT_BATCH_MAX_BATCH`)
2) Enable preemptive-shedding for streaming requests so short streams can cut the queue. (flag: `ENABLE_STREAM_PREEMPTIVE_SHED=true`)
3) Route streaming traffic to the low-latency pool (routing tag `stream-low-latency`) while we investigate KV host I/O.
4) If paging persists, temporarily pin heavy customers to quantized model variant to lower memory pressure.

Aisha (eng-oncall): I can flip 1 and 2. Ben, can you prepare the route change and Darya confirm capacity?

Darya (eng-platform): I can do the route move. Low-latency pool has spare capacity (we recently freed a few instances). Will coordinate with autoscaler if needed.

Aisha (eng-oncall): Executing changes now: lowering batch size and enabling shedding.

deploy-bot: Started rollout: change `CONT_BATCH_MAX_BATCH`=8 on tag=us-west-2 (shard cohort). Progress: 1/5 shards updated.

Aisha (eng-oncall): 2/5 shards updated. Preliminary p99 moving from 3.1s -> 2.0s in those shards.

Carlos (eng-sre): I'll open a ticket with infra to check EBS noisy neighbor on the KV hosts. Also bumping IO class to provisioned IOPS for the affected subset as a temporary measure.

Ben (eng-runtime): Routing traffic: switching streaming routes to `stream-low-latency` for the affected region. This will send new streaming sessions to the separate pool.

deploy-bot: Route update applied for /v1/generate (streaming) in us-west-2.

Aisha (eng-oncall): After the route move + batch size change: p99 across region dropped to 1.05s, streaming stall counts down by ~70%. p95 stable around 520-700ms.

Mitra (customer-success): Heads up — Support flagged 6 customers reporting slow interactive experiences in the last 20m. Could be the same. Evan, can you correlate support tickets and affected regions?

Evan (support): Checking now. 4 of the 6 are US-west customers, two are on Dedicated and experienced timeouts during long streaming sessions. Opening support-impact ticket and noting SLO exposure window.

Mitra (customer-success): Thanks. We'll prepare a short customer note if the p99 doesn't return to normal within the hour.

Carlos (eng-sre): Infra change: re-provisioned IOPS on 3 KV hosts in us-west-2a. Observability shows decreased iowait after the change.

Ben (eng-runtime): Follow-up tuning suggestion: add sequence-length-aware batching heuristics to reduce padding amplification. Short-term we can lower `MAX_BATCH_PAD_RATIO` from 2.5 -> 1.5 for mixed workloads. Would like to roll that as a staged tweak.

Aisha (eng-oncall): Agree. But we should test on a canary first. Ben, can you stage to canary cohort?

Ben (eng-runtime): Will stage to canary (cohort=c01) in 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for `MAX_BATCH_PAD_RATIO`=1.5 on cohort c01.

Aisha (eng-oncall): Handoff: I'm about to go offline for brief personal emergency. Ben, taking over primary oncall for this incident — summary: p99 spike due to KV host I/O causing streaming stalls amplified by large mixed len batches; mitigation done: reduced batch sizes, enabled preemptive shedding, routed streaming to low-latency pool, infra reprovisioned IOPS. Current status: p99 ~1.05s, streaming stalls down.

Ben (eng-runtime): Ack. I'll continue monitoring and follow up on canary results and pad-ratio rollout. Notifying SRE and Platform for deeper postmortem.

Aisha (eng-oncall): Thanks all — leaving notes in the incident log and adding runbook steps we followed.

Carlos (eng-sre): I'll open an incident ticket (INC-2025-0421) and tag the team. Need to track root cause of I/O bitflips on KV hosts.

Mitra (customer-success): Drafted a short customer alert describing degraded streaming latency between 12:05-12:50 PST affecting interactive sessions. Will hold until Ben confirms stable for 30m.

Ben (eng-runtime): 30m passed, p99 stable <1.1s. Approving customer message.

Mitra (customer-success): Sending notice to affected customers now.

Aisha (eng-oncall): Final notes: temporary mitigations reverted where safe (we left batch_size at 8 for now; pad-ratio canary shows improvement, will roll slowly). Root cause action items: deeper disk IO investigation, consider KV sharding changes, and implement seq-len-aware binning in the batcher.

Ben (eng-runtime): Closing handover. If anything regresses ping me. :thumbsup:
